logp.method_description: The HPLC-purified [99mTc]Tc-[Pen-Hx-sss-c(RGDfK)]2 was dissolved in 25 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) to prepare a sample solution. A 10 μL aliquot of the sample solution was mixed with 3 mL each of n-octanol and 25 mM phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) preincubated for 24 h to reach equilibrium. The mixture was vortexed for 1 min, and the mixture was left to stand for 1 min. This procedure was repeated three times. The mixtures were then centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 5 min. Two 1 mL aliquots of each phase were removed, and their radioactivity was determined with a well-type gamma counter.
